notes: Starter neighbourhood on World.MAP_W x World.MAP_H (the only place the map size is set). Starter neighbourhood. Road grid: vertical roads start at vroads_x, horizontal at hroads_y; every road is road_w wide (outer tile of each side = sidewalk, the road_w-2 between = asphalt). Block (c,r) is the lot slot between vroads_x[c]/vroads_x[c+1] and hroads_y[r]/hroads_y[r+1]; lot rects are lot_size and the slot origin is (vroads_x[c]+road_w, hroads_y[r]+road_w). Slots hold the lots of neighborhood.json (the template/label/type come from there).
